steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs by paginating through all pages
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
all_liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page or len(page) == 0:
        break
    all_liked_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total liked songs fetched: {len(all_liked_songs)}")
print("First few:", all_liked_songs[:3])
